$comment: Quality gates run by the Stop hook (cratis-quality-gate.sh).
Data, not code: a consuming repository overrides this file (or points CRATIS_HOOKS_GATES at
its own) without touching the script. Gates run in order and stop at the first failure.
A gate runs only when the working tree contains a change matching one of its "changed" globs,
AND every entry in "requires" is satisfied. An unsatisfied "requires" makes the gate a NO-OP
with a message on stderr — that is how a repo that has no .NET or no frontend stays quiet.
id               stable identifier, shown in failure output
description      one line, shown in the dry-run plan
changed          globs (repo-relative) that must match a changed file for the gate to run
excludeChanged   globs that never count as a relevant change
requires.commands executables that must be on PATH
requires.paths   repo-relative paths that must exist
workingDirectory repo-relative directory the command runs in
command          argv array — executed directly, never through a shell (no eval)
Commands are pinned to .ai/rules/general.md 'Quality Gates' and .ai/hooks/agent-stop.md.
This framework repository builds and tests AuthProxy.slnx in Debug, then verifies Release,

gates.description: dotnet build (Debug) — zero errors and zero warnings
dotnet build (Release) — zero errors and zero warnings
validate-ai-setup.sh — adapters, frontmatter and cross-links healthy
